Subject: RE: Calloway Apartments LP - New Submission

Hi Leon,

Thanks for the submission on Calloway Apartments LP. I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward with quoting.

I'll work this up and aim to have indicative terms back to you by end of week. The $10.2M TIV and loss history look reasonable for our appetite.

I'll reach out if any questions come up during the review, but at first glance we should be able to put something competitive together for the 11/30/26 effective date.

Appreciate the business!

Best,
[Underwriter name]
